This all checks out. The screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css` implement the edit profile screen using Strata components (`Card`, `TextField`, `DatePicker`, `Select`, `Avatar`, `Alert`, `Badge`, `Button`, `ToastRegion`).

Summary of what it does:
- Avatar with "Change photo" (file picker → object URL preview) and "Remove" once a photo is set.
- Full name, email, phone, date of birth, preferred language (English/Arabic/French/Hindi/Urdu) fields with mock initial data.
- Each changed field gets an "Edited" badge next to its label, plus a summary `Alert` listing everything changed since the last save, and a footer status line with the count.
- Cancel reverts to the last-saved values; Save validates (required name, valid email), simulates an async save, then shows a success toast and clears the changed-state.
- Layout uses logical CSS properties and flexbox so it mirrors correctly for the Arabic (RTL) locale.
